content: Empirically tested on Xcode 26.3 (17C529): xcodebuild -onlyUsePackageVersionsFromResolvedFile and -disableAutomaticPackageResolution are behaviourally indistinguishable aliases - identical -help text, and against an unsatisfiable pin both emit byte-identical 'an out-of-date resolved file was detected ... not allowed when automatic dependency resolution is disabled' and fail the build. Neither flag PINS versions; the on-disk Package.resolved does the pinning (a satisfiable pin is honored with or without the flags). The flags only convert silent re-resolution into a hard error. With no flag, an unsatisfiable pin is silently discarded and the build succeeds against a re-resolved version.
